title: Glowing paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='48' r='30' fill='#1a2a44' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- paper plane body: main bright cream lit -->
  <polygon points='14,46 84,20 52,64' fill='#f2f7ff'/>
  <!-- top fold lighter -->
  <polygon points='14,46 84,20 50,42' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- wing shading to separate parts -->
  <polygon points='50,42 84,20 52,64' fill='#cfe0fb'/>
  <!-- underside fold -->
  <polygon points='52,64 84,20 70,68' fill='#a9c4ee'/>
  <!-- small tail fold -->
  <polygon points='52,64 70,68 60,72' fill='#8aa9d8'/>
  <!-- motion trail -->
  <line x1='10' y1='60' x2='30' y2='52' stroke='#7ee7ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <line x1='6' y1='72' x2='26' y2='66' stroke='#5fc9f0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.65'/>
  <line x1='14' y1='82' x2='34' y2='78' stroke='#5fc9f0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='34' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='1.6' fill='#aef4ff'/>
</svg>
